factoids.title: A Stevie Wonder foundation
factoids.content: Coolio’s recording draws on Stevie Wonder’s “Pastime Paradise.” The sample relationship gives the track a direct connection to Wonder’s earlier recording.

factoids.title: A studio-built arrangement
factoids.content: Producer Doug Rasheed recalled revisiting the drums and strengthening the strings during the final mix. The track came together across four studios, including his home studio.
